findings.defect: The table loop starts a record at a high/critical row, remembers a Package value and commits immediately at a canonical More info cell. It does not require the source table's range/Paths rows, row order, separators or closing table boundary. Blank-label continuation rows fall through silently. Consequently a truncated three-row pseudo-table can reach QUALIFIED_REPORTED_FACTS with a consistent summary. More seriously, a Package value equal to a manifest member followed by a continuation is salvaged as that member, and a canonical advisory URL prefix followed by a continuation is salvaged as its ID, even though the complete retained cell is not that exact value.

The loop ignores both, then line169 publishes a qualified advisory reason. This is a source trace, not an executed repro or actual audit observation.

Status.wrapping_distinction: Pinned source applies width54/wrapWord to the entire right column, not just retained fields. Title, vulnerable/patched ranges and Paths may legitimately wrap while being discarded; Paths also deliberately joins entries with blank lines at133173-133176. Such physical continuations are not by themselves evidence of an invalid pnpm report. Retained Package and More info continuations are different: accepting only their first physical line can misstate exact membership/canonical-cell identity. The current plan's blanket wrapped=>UNKNOWN rule is a permitted conservative boundary. Any narrower policy allowing well-framed continuations only for discarded fields must be explicit in the versioned contract before correction review, with row-state controls; it must never silently relax retained-cell refusal or persist discarded content.
